subject: 1st order reflective 2nd order formative in lavaan

messages.author: b048c97bee0de8a7
messages.subject: 1st order reflective 2nd order formative in lavaan
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to develop a measurement, 1st order reflective 2nd order formative. But, my syntax doesn't work…

Would you please give me advice?

My model is following:

model = 
"

1st_order_factor_One =~ a1 + a2 + a3
1st_order_factor_Two =~ b1 + b2 + b3
1st_order_factor_Three =~ c1 + c2 + c3

2nd_order_factor <- 1st_order_factor_One + 1st_order_factor_Two + 1st_order_factor_Three

2nd_order_factor ~ 1st_order_factor_One + 1st_order_factor_Two + 1st_order_factor_Three

"


fit = sem(model, data = data, std.ov=TRUE,std.lv=TRUE)


Thank you very much for your invaluable advice in advance.

Sincerely,

Yonghwan Chang

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: 1st order reflective 2nd order formative in lavaan
parts:
Both of these lines of syntax do the same thing.  That is, the parameters specified with <~ are the same as those defined by ~

Even with only one of the above specifications, I don't think you're model is identified because 2nd_order_factor doesn't predict any other observed (or identified latent) variables.

Terry
